title: RAW UNASSESSED: prospective dy repetitions as a whole-field unary tally
summary: Root-supplied small hypothesis: a positive integer n is written as n copies of one tally mark X; the prospective literal carrier is X=dy, restricted to complete independently bounded tally fields. The elementary source inverse is complete, but no native numeric namespace, unit, counted entity or quantity is identified. This does not translate native dy as one and does not treat embedded -dy as a numeral.

design.source_domain: A finite ordered sequence of positive integers. Each source integer is one numeric field; zero, negative values, fractions, units and entity names are outside this small module. The empty sequence is permitted. Source field boundaries are explicit and preserved. This is not a full prose writer.
design.writer: Write n copies of a single taught abstract tally mark X for each positive integer n. Put one definite visible space between numeric fields, with no spaces inside a field; the empty sequence writes the empty string. In the prospective literal realization write the two working units d,y for each X, so each numeric field has the exact form (dy)^n. Do not add subtractive rules or change notation at four.
design.reader: Within the declared numeric-only source namespace, split at definite field spaces. Require every nonempty field to consist of one or more exact dy pairs and return its number of pairs. Reject malformed fields and uncertain boundaries rather than changing segmentation. The inverse returns the ordered integer sequence exactly. It does not identify a unit or counted object.
design.abstract_example: The source sequence [1,3,2,4] writes X XXX XX XXXX, or prospectively dy dydydy dydy dydydydy. These are teaching outputs only, not translations of manuscript occurrences. Four remains four tally marks; this is not complete Roman notation and dy is not assigned a Latin I value.
native_adoption_debt: A native field selector must independently establish which complete groups are numeric, where each field begins/ends and what quantity, unit or entity it belongs to. The module does not supply that selector. It is not licensed to call every convenient dy-string a tally while silently exempting inconvenient occurrences.
No special value is assigned to embedded terminal -dy or to dy as part of a larger nonunary group. Those uses cannot be pooled with standalone whole-group evidence.
No whole-passage source, ordinary-letter key, reference vocabulary, numeric translation or mixed text/numeral escape rule is selected. The surrounding prose remains unread.

Grouping matters: a definite dy dy dy would be three numeric fields in this source contract, whereas a definite dydydy is one field. An uncertain small gap cannot be silently chosen to obtain the desired quantity.

Neither is an independently bound numeric label or evidence for quantity one. No image has been inspected for this proposal.

design.conditional_content_consequence: Only after a numeric namespace and counted unit have been independently bound does adding one X increase the represented cardinality by exactly one, and joining two numeric fields without a gap changes two separate values into their sum. This is the unary source law, not an observed native equation. Equality of tally length does not imply identity of the counted entities.
